1.consolidated_definition: Pilote. Estaca gruesa y larga que se hinca en el terreno que no es firme para poder construir sobre ella estructuras pesadas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Pilot stake. A thick and long stake that is driven into the ground where it is not firm in order to support heavy structures.
